summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue with the `ordered` property for GROUP BY queries, but it may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch modifies the behavior of the `ordered` property, which could potentially affect other parts of the codebase that rely on this property. It is unclear if this change introduces any behavioral regressions.

The patch adds a comment that could be improved for clarity. The comment mentions 'default ordering is not applied when GROUP BY is used,' but it might be more helpful to explain why this is the case.
